WITH status_shares AS (
  SELECT
    powerstatus,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY powerstatus
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(ss.telescope_count) AS total_telescope_count,
  AVG(ss.share) AS average_share,
  AVG(ss.share - a.average_share) AS average_share_above_average
FROM status_shares AS ss
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE ss.share > a.average_share;
